messages:
maria: onboarding zenith6b v1.2. using head-fusion + int4 and seeing reproducible quality delta on longctx after KV warmup. baseline fp16 matches.

jin: can you share the exact command + commit?

maria: `python eval/longctx_repro.py --model zenith6b --commit abc123 --quant int4 --head-fuse on --prompt tests/long_prompt.txt`

maria: sample diff:
```
- expected: "The conservation of energy implies..."
+ actual:   "The conservation of energy impli3s..."
```

oliver: quick smoke: headwise sign flips on heads [4,9,21], KV-cache offset by +1 token for those heads after fusion.

eva: likely rotary phase alternation or head packing reorder. does disabling fusion revert to baseline?

maria: yes - fusion=off matches fp16. int8 similar milder regression.

jin: check convert_ckpt.py/headpack utils for even/odd reorder. add checksum on tokenmap.

oliver: hackfix worked locally: normalize sign for odd heads before fusion. adding unit test `tests/test_headfusion_rotary.py` to detect this.

eva: triage plan: 1) detect per-head phase pattern across layers 2) inspect conversion history 3) run 100-prompt smoke (queued).

triage-bot: Benchmark queued `/runs/6790` (zenith6b int4 head-fusion smoke). ETA ~40m.

maria: opening PRs: conversion guard + runtime fallback to disable head-fusion when alternating phases detected.
